row.proto: int64_t Ne_JobQueue_SubmitJobRange(void *queue, int64_t *range, void *arg, uint32_t flagA, uint8_t flagB)
row.notes: Submits a range of job records (range[0] begin, [1] stride, [2] end, [3] minimum size) under the critical section at queue+0x28. Returns 1 with errno 1 when queue+0x164 (shut down) is set. Pushes each record via 0x143ac00e0 (direct to a worker) or 0x143ac2340 (deferred batch) depending on queue+0x10 and the pending counter at +0x160, then kicks the scheduler. The callee names in the KB say Render_Streaming but the physics world uses the same queue.
